notes: Context: Mid-market B2B SaaS analytics product. Building an in-app conversational assistant + reranking search for knowledge base + embeddings for similarity search.

Observed traffic (during POC replay window):
- Peak observed QPS: 18 QPS (10:45 PST spike during batch reindex), typical peak per-customer ~6-8 QPS
- Sustained baseline during daytime: ~3.5-6 QPS
- Avg concurrency (open sessions / simultaneous streaming responses): 9-12 concurrent streams at peak
- Token mix (approx): prompt avg 80 tokens, completion avg 160 tokens; embeddings avg 512 dims calls at ~450 tokens preprocessed. Overall token ratio completion:prompt ~2:1
Cost sensitivity: mid-market; wants clear per-token and per-embedding unit forecast. CFO asked for 30% reduction vs mock hosted overage projections — hence exploring Dedicated reserved capacity.
Performance targets: p50 < 140ms per token generation, p95 < 600ms for conversational prompts at 512 context; embeddings < 250ms per call (for real-time similarity within UI).

Dedicated sizing ask (from SE workshop 2026-03-02): provide sizing for 3 profiles — conservative, expected, growth (3x growth over 12 months). SE recommended:

- Expected profile (recommended initial): target sustained QPS 10, peak 25 QPS, concurrency headroom 20, token mix as observed. Suggest 4 x 80GB GPUs (in Dedicated pool) with autoscale buffer + burst capacity to cloud-hosted spare nodes.
- Conservative: 6 x 80GB GPUs for heavy-burst customers (if they need lower p95), higher monthly commit but lower overage risk.

- Growth plan: scale to 10 x 80GB GPUs within 6 months via staged rollouts and canary >50% traffic. Redwood SE proposed CPU-based embedding offload for cheaper embedding unit costs during low-latency windows.
